newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castorseed falls, overseas buying still low.
newsitem.headline: Indian castorseed falls, overseas buying still low.

text.p: Indian castorseed March delivery prices fell on Friday to 1,147/1,148 rupees per quintal from 1,155/1,156 rupees as overseas buying remained low, dealers said.
"Overseas buying remained low while higher new crop arrivals prompted fresh bull liquidation," one dealer said. "Active selling by bears also dragged prices down."
New crop arrivals of castorseed in the Gujarat region rose to 35/40,000 bags (75 kg each). Arrivals from southern India also picked up.
Castorseed June delivery eased by 8/10 rupees to 1,215/1,220 rupees per quintal on the back of losses in the March delivery.
But trading in June delivery was nominal.

Groundnut oil gained marginally by 2/3 rupees to 340/342 rupees per 10 kg on fresh physical buying at the lower level ahead of the Moslim Ramzan festival. Imported palm oil was quiet at 280/281 rupees per 10 kg. In Rajkot spot groundnut oil remained steady at 510/515 rupees per 15 kg.
